overview: Tregenna Castle sits on a hill above St Ives harbour in 72 acres of grounds looking over St Ives Bay. Guests can choose between sea-view hotel rooms, family apartments, or self-catering cottages and lodges. On site there is an indoor pool, a restaurant, a bar and a beauty treatment service, and walks run through the grounds towards the coast.
surfTripFit: A comfortable, facility-rich base for mixed groups or families visiting St Ives Bay, though the official site gives no beach distance or surfer-specific facilities.
